interaction_history.overview: When missile technology is used to enhance toy action figures, the toys soon begin to take their battle programming too seriously.
interaction_history.title: Small Soldiers

interaction_history.overview: Princess Leia is captured and held hostage by the evil Imperial forces in their effort to take over the galactic Empire. Venturesome Luke Skywalker and dashing captain Han Solo team together with the loveable robot duo R2-D2 and C-3PO to rescue the beautiful princess and restore peace and justice in the Empire.
interaction_history.title: Star Wars: Episode IV - A New Hope

interaction_history.overview: A lone prospector ventures into Alaska looking for gold. He gets mixed up with some burly characters and falls in love with the beautiful Georgia. He tries to win her heart with his singular charm.
interaction_history.title: Gold Rush, The

interaction_history.overview: A mentally unstable Vietnam War veteran works as a night-time taxi driver in New York City where the perceived decadence and sleaze feeds his urge for violent action, attempting to save a preadolescent prostitute in the process.
interaction_history.title: Taxi Driver

interaction_history.overview: The first half of this film, set hundreds of years ago, shows how the old man who eventually became Santa Claus was given immortality and chosen to deliver toys to all the children of the world. The second half moves into the modern era, in which Patch, the head elf, strikes out on his own and falls in with an evil toy manufacturer who wants to corner the market and eliminate Santa Claus.
interaction_history.title: Santa Claus: The Movie

interaction_history.overview: On another planet in the distant past, a Gelfling embarks on a quest to find the missing shard of a magical crystal and restore order to his world, before the grotesque race of Skeksis find and use the crystal for evil.
interaction_history.title: Dark Crystal, The

interaction_history.overview: A quartet of mutated humanoid turtles clash with an uprising criminal gang of ninjas
interaction_history.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles

interaction_history.overview: Leaving the safety of their nursery behind, Wendy, Michael and John follow Peter Pan to a magical world where childhood lasts forever. But while in Neverland, the kids must face Captain Hook and foil his attempts to get rid of Peter for good.
interaction_history.title: Peter Pan

interaction_history.overview: A businessman is reunited with the four lost souls who were his guardian angels during childhood, all with a particular purpose to joining the afterlife.
interaction_history.title: Heart and Souls

interaction_history.overview: A young boy must restore order when a group of bullies steal the magical book that acts as a portal between Earth and the imaginary world of Fantasia.
interaction_history.title: NeverEnding Story III, The
